title: Molecular Characterization Initiative (MCI), pediatric meningioma subset
institution: Children's Hospital of Philadelphia (CCDI Data Coordinating Center) / National Cancer Institute Childhood Cancer Data Initiative
needs_manual_review_reason: NEW RECORD (2026-07-11), found via a discovery search of GDC (Genomic Data Commons), a database never previously searched by this project (prior documentation only checked TCGA specifically, confirming no dedicated meningioma project exists there, but GDC hosts many other programs beyond TCGA). CCDI-MCI ('Molecular Characterization Initiative') is a large NCI Childhood Cancer Data Initiative pan-pediatric-cancer profiling program (3,093 total cases across many disease types, e.g. Nevi and Melanomas, Gliomas, Leukemias, Meningiomas, Adenomas, etc.), NOT a meningioma-specific project, but 'Meningiomas' is confirmed as one of its genuine, real disease-type categories, not an incidental keyword collision. Verified directly via the GDC REST API: filtering cases by project.project_id=CCDI-MCI and disease_type=*meningioma* returns exactly 31 cases, all with disease_type literally 'Meningiomas'; expanding these cases' file lists confirms real deposited molecular data, not just clinical records: 62 whole-exome sequencing files (access: controlled) and 84 DNA methylation array files (access: open) across these 31 cases. This is a genuine, substantial pediatric meningioma cohort; pediatric meningioma is rare and was essentially unrepresented in this inventory before this record (the only other pediatric-focused record is gse-317578-methylation, a Heidelberg cohort). No linked publication was found, this is an active data-generation consortium program (part of NCI's Childhood Cancer Data Initiative), not a single-paper study; corresponding_author and institution reflect the coordinating center, not an individual investigator. patient_count/sample_count set to 31 (the confirmed case count); the true number of distinct samples (a case can have multiple files/aliquots) was not resolved beyond the case-level count in this pass. modality includes both wes (controlled access) and dna_methylation_array (open access, GDC's own experimental_strategy field lists this as 'Methylation Array' though the exact platform/chip was not confirmed). Only public GDC case/file summary-level metadata was used; the controlled-access WXS data itself was never accessed, per docs/scope.md's compliance guardrail; the open-access methylation array data's actual files were not downloaded in this pass either, only their existence and count were confirmed via the API. FACT-CHECK CORRECTION (2026-07-11 re-verification pass): verification_tier was set to 1 ('Corroborated, 2+ independent found_via paths') but found_via lists only a single path ('keyword_api'), which per docs/controlled_vocabulary.md is the definition of tier 2 ('Single-path verified'), not tier 1. Independently re-verified the underlying GDC data live (re-queried api.gdc.cancer.gov/projects/CCDI-MCI?expand=summary and the cases/files facet endpoints): the 31-case, 146-file (62 WXS controlled + 84 methylation-array open, matching a 56 Masked Intensities + 28 Methylation Beta Value split) figures are all still accurate and reproduce exactly. Only the tier/found_via mismatch was wrong; corrected verification_tier from 1 to 2 since only one found_via path is documented and no second independent path was found in this pass either.
